description: This file contains internal testing references for PyTorch operations, including class definitions and utility functions to manage OpInfo objects for Python-based operation references used in testing and experimental features.

classes.name: PythonRefInfo

classes.name: ReductionPythonRefInfo

classes.name: ElementwiseUnaryPythonRefInfo

classes.name: ElementwiseBinaryPythonRefInfo
classes.description: An OpInfo class for Python references of binary elementwise operations, inheriting from BinaryUfuncInfo.
